Dedicated egress: the exit is yours alone, with no shared bandwidth or reputation.

Optional IEPL: fixed-path transit that flattens peak-hour latency and loss.

tiktok-live-ip.title: Live stream keeps dropping? Stabilise the network layer first
tiktok-live-ip.subtitle: We match a dedicated residential egress to your live region, add IEPL transit when needed, then advise bitrate and keyframe settings so network and encoder are configured together.
tiktok-live-ip.keywords: live streaming network,live uplink IP,dedicated residential IP,IEPL transit
pains: It drops every ten minutes and viewers do not stay.
Peak-hour blur: the bitrate simply will not hold.
Switching networks triggers verification and kills the schedule.
Several live rooms share one egress and drag each other down.
You cannot tell whether it is the network, the device or the settings.
solutions: Region match: stream to a market, use a residential egress in that market.
Dedicated egress: one line per live room, with no bandwidth contention.
IEPL transit: a fixed path around public congestion, with steadier latency and loss.
Uplink headroom: reserve roughly 30% above target bitrate so peaks do not saturate the line.
Encoder guidance: resolution, frame rate, bitrate and keyframe interval by device.
scenarios: Parallel live rooms in multiple regions
Live streaming plus store admin on one environment

specs.region: US / UK / Germany / Japan / Taiwan / Philippines
specs.devices: Desktop encoders, mobile streaming, common hardware encoders

faq.a: Not absolutely, but a dedicated egress on a fixed path controls the variables that actually matter.

faq.q: How much uplink do I need?
faq.a: Reserve about 30% above target bitrate; the exact figure depends on resolution and frame rate.

faq.q: Can I run a test stream?
faq.a: Yes. A 30-minute test is scheduled before activation.

faq.q: Can I stream from a phone?
faq.a: Yes, on iOS and Android. Setup instructions come with the delivery notes.
One line per region, assigned per live room, so regions are never mixed.

faq.q: Do I have to rebuy to change region?
faq.a: No. Lines are adjusted to the new region and the difference is settled as used.
Yes, we provide a working starting profile for your device and target quality.

faq.q: What should I check when the picture breaks up?
faq.a: Look at loss and uplink saturation first, then encoder settings, then the local network.

productMeta.title: Network details

compare.datacenter: Datacenter IP: cheap and fast, but concentrated ranges are easy for platforms to flag.
compare.shared: Shared residential IP: moderate cost, but the egress is shared and reputation is unpredictable.
compare.dedicated: Dedicated static residential IP: highest cost, but fixed, clean and explainable.

productMeta.faqQ1: How do I verify it is residential?
productMeta.faqA1: Check the ASN owner and blocklists, or request a test IP and verify it yourself.
productMeta.faqQ2: What is the difference between dedicated and shared?
productMeta.faqA2: Dedicated egress is exclusive to you. Shared is cheaper but stability cannot be controlled.
productMeta.faqQ3: Which devices and protocols are supported?
productMeta.faqA3: Windows, macOS, iOS, Android and routers. Protocols follow the product page and delivery notes.
